design: Secondary comparison using every preserved pilot sample; candidate outcomes already known. No candidate or data tuning. Freeze and push this protocol and implementation before evaluating comparator decisions.
source: Tudball et al., Biometrika 110 (2023), 485-498, DOI 10.1093/biomet/asac042; main equations (8)-(9), Remarks 1-2; published supplement section 4.2 equation (4)
allocation_explanation: Paper Remark 2 with alpha1=alpha2=.025 requests constraint failure alpha1/2=.0125. Author R code uses z_(1-alpha/4) for both a single two-sided constraint and an objective tail, corresponding to shared_default. The same constraint event can be counted once for the two target tails. Fixed sensitivity allocations are separate comparators; never combine their decisions without adjustment.
variance: Categorical plug-in second moment minus squared mean, as in supplement equation (4), dividing by n. Author regression R implementation uses unbiased sample variance; it is not a categorical package call.
optimizer: Global analytic extrema of Q over the relaxed balance set and [1,R]^3. Compute standard error at that optimizer afterward; do not optimize Q plus or minus standard error.
empty_set: Return unresolved and record emptiness separately; also report flag-on-empty sensitivity, taking the more powerful convention for the feasibility comparison. Neither convention is falsely attributed to a successful package call.
zero_counts: Return unresolved on zero category or n<2 and report guard frequency; finite multinomial law audit bounds omitted probability. No pilot count is silently discarded.
decision: Flag when the computed interval is strictly disjoint from the nominated tolerance band; otherwise unresolved. Same n,R, full marked order and known generated balance; no true detector pattern supplied.
validity: Source procedure is asymptotic under regularity conditions. Boundary empty-set and constraint qualification issues must be reported. This study cannot upgrade it to a uniform finite guarantee or declare strongest-method superiority.
evaluation: All 128 saved strata, 256 decision rows, all 12 allocation/representation comparators. Report null diagnostics, empty frequencies, both empty conventions, paired differences, and all failures.
feasibility_gate: Candidate lower 99% CP power >=.8 and paired family-adjusted Hoeffding improvement >=.1 over every auxiliary comparator under either empty convention, as well as all three original comparators, in at least one biased alternative stratum. This is a secondary screen, not a new confirmatory experiment.
independent_checks: scalar root-finding against analytic ratio interval
independent SLSQP objective optimization at controlled strictly feasible problems
symmetry and exact R=1 objective limits
direct finite-law probabilities for original three passing settings
hash verification and replay of saved counts
next_gate: If the gain survives, evaluate an exact joint multinomial comparator before closing the best-existing-method requirement; physical observation and calibration remain mandatory.
scope: No change to original protocol, counts, results, manuscripts or published artifacts. No Lean run. No physical evidence claimed. Goal remains active.
